THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

Your class is playing an escape room game at a museum. You are alone in the last room, with ten minutes left. The door opens when four steps are in order. The steps show how one new law moves. Four people each have one step.

THE HISTORY

This room is about the Navajo Nation government. In 1989 the Navajo Nation made three branches, like the United States. The Council makes the laws, and the President leads. Courts decide what the laws mean.
